title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-28; battery output below zero is charging
source_line: Source: CAISO, EIA via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_battery_storage, eia930_all_demand; data retrieved to 2026-10-30.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). Today's Outlook: batteries trend (storage.csv history). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `caiso_battery_storage`, ERW commit 75b92b7b4c20.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). Form EIA-930, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor: hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and interchange by balancing authority. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `eia930_all_demand`, ERW commit 75b92b7b4c20.
facts: CAISO, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-28: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 18:00 Pacific at 32779.13 MW, when batteries delivered a mean 8413.6 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 18:00, 8413.6 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 11:00, -8578.54 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-29: 6763.2 MW.
